answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 24647 Country: India Title: I have attended a marriage. were there is no quthba and dua. i was told as per sunnath no need of this . please clear my dought Question: I have attended a marriage. were there is no quthba and dua. i was told as per sunnath no need of this . please clear my dought Answer ID: 24647 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1592/1264/B=1431) The sunnah way is that first the khutbah of nikah should be recited, then ijab-o-qubool (proper exchange of words of nikah). However, the nikah will be valid if only ijab-o-qubool has been conducted without khutbah . However, a nikah without khutbah does not have that much blessing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
